description: Gujarat's Chief Minister inaugurated the Regional AI Impact Conference, showcasing the state's commitment to integrating AI into governance and economic growth. The event launched the Gujarat AI Stack and cloud adoption guidelines, alongside MoUs with Google and Bhashini to advance AI capabilities and multilingual services.
body_lead: AI-led governance gets Gujarat thrust as CM Bhupendra Patel launches tech stack, signs MoUs and sets 2047 roadmap Gujarat's Chief Minister inaugurated the Regional AI Impact Conference, showcasing the state's commitment to integrating AI into governance and economic growth. The event launched the Gujarat AI Stack and cloud adoption guidelines, alongside MoUs with Google and Bhashini to advance AI capabilities and multilingual services.
